scope: Conservative documented cases, not an asserted lifetime total. Original records remain the source of truth.

definitions.films: One completed authored story/promo/tutorial/ambient master per case. Aspect, language and revision variants count once. A finished export need not be publicly published or creatively accepted.
definitions.trials: One executed bounded trial or comparison suite. Partial, failed and incomplete attempts count as conducted; routine unit checks, retries and plans do not. Films and trials can overlap; do not add them together.
